_meta.review_notes: Q01 (SELECT * FROM rental LIMIT 10) produces Limit -> SeqScan on rental with estimated plan_rows=16472, actual rows=10 (Limit-truncated). SCAN-001 fires: pure full scan (no Filter), est 16472 > threshold 10000, parent Limit is not a 'legitimate full scan' ancestor (allowlist excludes Limit). detail template 'Seq Scan on %{relation} scanned ~%{rows} rows (threshold: %{threshold})' with relation=rental, rows=16472, threshold=10000. SCAN-004 does NOT fire (no Filter property). GEN-001 does NOT fire (depth=2 < threshold 10). SCAN-005 does NOT fire (rule only matches IndexScan/IndexOnlyScan/CStoreIndexScan, not SeqScan). EST-004 does NOT fire (no Nested Loop node in plan).

anti_findings.reason: SCAN-004 requires a Filter property on the scan node. Q01's SeqScan is a pure full scan (parent Limit truncates output, not a Filter).
SCAN-005 (IndexScanPoorSelectivity) only matches IndexScan / IndexOnlyScan / CStoreIndexScan / PartitionedIndexScan. Q01 is a SeqScan.
GEN-001 (PlanTooDeep) fires when plan depth exceeds max_plan_depth (default 10). Q01 depth = 2 (Limit -> SeqScan).
EST-004 (NestedLoopFromUnderestimation) requires a Nested Loop node. Q01 has Limit -> SeqScan, no join.
